Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have a shared plan: 

- What we heard: primary goal is to reduce inference latency for your customer-facing search assistant while keeping data isolated to your VPC.
- Suggested fit: a short Dedicated pilot or Redwood Private (VPC) deploy would align with your security and data isolation asks; Dedicated is faster to pilot, VPC gives you full network control.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm pilot priority & target start week (we penciled May 4).
2) Internal kickoff: 30–45m technical sync to scope network/egress and data flow (Dev would own).
3) We'll surface a short cost-delta summary (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC) and SOC2 summary for procurement.

Are you still targeting early May for a pilot? If timelines have shifted, tell me what window works and we’ll replan.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt

Alex —

Great — thanks for the update and the budget context. Answers below and attaching the requested artifacts:

1) One-paragraph tradeoff (Dedicated vs VPC):
Dedicated: fastest to stand up (2–5 business days for a trimmed pilot), lower immediate setup cost, Redwood manages runtime; good when you want predictable throughput quickly but are okay with host-managed networking.
VPC (Private): longer procurement and networking work (2–6 weeks typical), higher initial setup for VPC peering and security review, but gives you full control over network egress, private IPs, and the ability to enforce your own audit policies. Cost delta depends on committed capacity and expected throughput — we’ll send a tailored delta for the 50 rps pilot but expect a modest premium (~15–30%) for VPC in the short window.

2) Compliance / logs for pilot in a VPC:
- Redwood provides redacted control-plane logs and full request/response audit logs directed to your logging endpoint (you control retention).
- Live metrics (latency, token counts, error rates) are available via our Console to authorized ClearLedger accounts.
- We can enable verbose tracing for the pilot window and deliver a zipped log bundle at the end of the run.

3) Pilot scope options: 50 rps for two weeks is fine — Dev and I can draft a minimal Master Action Plan (attached) and a lightweight runbook for rollback/fallback.

Next steps:
- I attached: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (short excerpt), pilot-MAP.xlsx (scope & tasks).
- Can we schedule a 30m scoping call on Tue Apr 21 or Wed Apr 22? Here’s my calendar: https://cal.com/hannah-schmitt/30min

If that timing won't work given your budget cycle, we can shift to a June start — just tell us your preferred window and we’ll prepare the documents accordingly.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
